[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Buying and Selling Ships[/color][/head]
Shipyard consoles sell faction-approved vessels and record ownership on a [bold]Shuttle Ownership Chip (SOC)[/bold]. New players should crew an existing ship before purchasing one.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Buying a ship[/color][/head]
1. Activate an available shipyard console and review the vessel's price, role, and restrictions. 2. Confirm that you have permission and enough funding. Some faction consoles draw from restricted funds or enforce a per-round vessel limit. 3. Select the vessel and confirm the purchase. The console prints an SOC containing the ship's deed. 4. Keep the SOC safe. The console reports whether the new vessel docked successfully or arrived nearby, including its direction when applicable. 5. Before departure, locate the helm, power controls, emergency equipment, air supply, and a way to communicate with your station.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Selling a ship[/color][/head]
1. Return the ship to a compatible shipyard and dock it securely. 2. Have [bold]every crew member disembark[/bold]. The console refuses a sale while crew remain aboard. 3. Insert the vessel's SOC into the shipyard console and review the appraisal. 4. Confirm the sale only after removing personal or faction property you intend to keep.
[color=#d9776c]A completed sale removes the vessel. Treat the confirmation as irreversible and never sell a ship out from under its crew.[/color]
For earning funds and leaving a long shift safely, see [textlink="Frontier Work and Cryosleep" link="UnionFrontier"].
